raw:
The 2022 British Grand Prix was won by Carlos Sainz of Ferrari. It was round 10 of the 2022 season, held at Silverstone on 3 July 2022. He started from pole, and Sergio Pérez (Red Bull) finished second and Lewis Hamilton (Mercedes) third.

ANSWER: Carlos Sainz
